correctness.rationale: Equation (1) follows from a projected disk plus axial segment; elementary beta integrals give all first three raw moments. The normalized second moment is a quadratic with exact reflection sum, and the cubic secant on reflected pairs is strictly negative using a rational bound on the sign of p^4−6p^3+4p²+36p−64 at p=π. This proves all positive finite radii/heights and sharp endpoint cases. The standalone program confirmed rational sign inequalities, 21 moment quadratures, direct polygonal projections and an exact analytic two-moment alias; finite checks are corroborative.

value.rationale: A natural unlabeled geometric measurement of a two-parameter convex-body family yields a full sharp inverse theorem. The first moment gives total surface-area scale, the second has a genuine two-solution aspect-ratio phase, and the third is proven to separate all remaining pairs by a nontrivial uniform strict polynomial inequality. The result precisely identifies information gained by higher moments in stereological reconstruction rather than a cosmetic formula or small numerical improvement.
